about.title: A steadfast, flexible partner for pet care brands
about.intro: HELICORP (short for Healthy Living Corporation) is a leading name in Vietnam's pet care technology market. We chose pet care as the first chapter of a broader mission: helping people live healthier lives, one household at a time. HELICORP is less a single company than a business mindset — steady, adaptable, and always building toward the next stage of growth.

values.title: Integrity
values.body: Transparent, honest reporting. We own our mistakes and work through problems in the open.

values.title: Professionalism
values.body: High standards and continuous learning, so partners and customers get consistent results.

values.title: Companionship
values.body: We build relationships on trust, walking alongside partners and employees through both setbacks and wins.

values.title: Innovation
values.body: We look for better ways to solve problems and stay ahead of a fast-moving market.

values.title: Dedication
values.body: Full commitment to every project, with the extra effort that exceeds expectations.

about.visionBody: To lead the Vietnamese market by pioneering advanced pet care technology, setting the standard other players measure themselves against.
about.missionBody: To deliver technology-driven solutions that improve quality of life and happiness for families and their pets alike.
about.strategyBody: HELICORP's strategy mirrors its name: steady and adaptable, like a helicopter — moving deliberately into demanding niche markets and adjusting course quickly, always climbing toward new heights.
about.omnichannelIntro: Three channels, one seamless experience for the customer at the other end.

channelOffline.title: Offline Channel
channelOffline.body: Flagship stores — including HELIPET Dinh Tien Hoang (HCMC) and HELIPET Thuy Khue (Hanoi) — plus shelf presence at major retail partners such as AEON Mall and Lotte Mart.

channelOnline.title: Online Channel
channelOnline.body: 15+ official storefronts across Vietnam's largest marketplaces, including Shopee, TikTok Shop and Lazada.

channelB2B.title: B2B Partner Channel
channelB2B.body: A dealer network of 10+ points of sale, concentrated around petshops and cat cafés that share our target customer.

about.facilitiesIntro: Physical infrastructure behind the brand: offices, warehousing and retail space across Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi, run against four operating pillars.

facilitiesPillars.title: Automated Operations
facilitiesPillars.body: Process automation across warehousing and fulfillment.

facilitiesPillars.title: Market Leadership
facilitiesPillars.body: Category-leading share in smart pet care.

facilitiesPillars.title: Customer Experience
facilitiesPillars.body: Service standards built for repeat trust.

facilitiesPillars.title: Brand Protection
facilitiesPillars.body: Safeguarding partner brands at every touchpoint.

history.title: How we got here
history.intro: From a first conversation with a single brand to a nationwide distribution network — the milestones that shaped HELICORP.

milestones.title: The Beginning
items: Opened negotiations with PETKIT on developing the brand in Vietnam.

milestones.title: Foundation & Establishment
items: Reached agreement to develop the PETKIT brand in Vietnam.
HeLiPet, HeLiCorp and Max Clean established (June 24, 2022).

milestones.title: Strategic Partnerships & Retail Expansion
items: Deepened cooperation with PETKIT for continued development in Vietnam.
Signed an exclusive partnership with Petree under the HeLiPet brand.
HeLiCorp products launched on shelves at AEON.

milestones.title: Major Growth & Diversification
items: Signed an exclusive distribution partnership for Dr.Vet products.
Reached an exclusive agreement with Neakasa in Vietnam.
Opened conversations with partners in the Cambodian market.
HeLiCorp products launched on shelves at LotteMart.
Established a branch office in Hanoi.

milestones.title: Exclusive Product Innovation
items: Partnered exclusively with Petree to develop the HELIPET OPEN TOP next-generation litter box.
Opened the first HeLiPet showroom in District 1, HCMC — the first store in our high-tech pet product retail chain.

culture.title: What makes HELICORP different
culture.intro: A working culture built over years, around a highly committed team and a shared set of habits.

pillars.title: Growth & Passion
pillars.body: Every day is a chance to learn, create and work with real enthusiasm — outstanding individuals building something extraordinary together.

pillars.title: Skill Up
pillars.body: Ongoing investment in technical skill, with a learning culture built around people who care about pets and about doing better work.

pillars.title: Team Engagement
pillars.body: A shared journey of growth, reinforced by regular team building and knowledge-sharing events.

pillars.title: Talent Pipeline
pillars.body: Proactively building a strong talent pool — discovering, attracting and training people with an entrepreneurial mindset.

culture.workingEnvBody: A modern, welcoming workplace with the amenities and green space to make it somewhere people are glad to come back to — dynamic, open and friendly by design.
culture.trainingBody: People are the biggest lever on the company's growth, so HELICORP runs internal training programs and supports employees taking outside courses to keep skills current.

forAgents.title: Become a partner with HELICORP
forAgents.intro: Expand your reach and build value in Vietnam's pet care technology industry alongside its leading distributor. With a proven business model and an extensive distribution network, we're looking for partners to grow the market together.
why: Official exclusive distributor for PETKIT, NEAKASA, PETREE and Dr.VET in Vietnam.
Owner of proprietary brands including HELIPET and Max Clean.
Took PETKIT to an 80% market share in smart pet care e-commerce.
forAgents.opsBody: A mature set of processes across sales, e-commerce, after-sales and marketing, backed by import, customs, warehousing and delivery services that get products to customers quickly.
forAgents.channelOnlineBody: 15+ official storefronts on Shopee, TikTok Shop and Lazada, plus dedicated e-commerce sites for our brands.
forAgents.channelOfflineBody: Key account presence at AEON Mall and Lotte Mart, alongside flagship stores for direct product experience.
forAgents.channelB2BBody: 10+ points of sale through a strategic dealer network, focused on petshops and cat cafés.
forAgents.mapBody: A distribution footprint spanning all 34 provinces and cities in Vietnam, anchored by hubs in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi.
excellenceItems: A service strategy covering pre-sale, sale and post-sale, refined against best-in-class retail models.
Clear, consistent processes across sales, e-commerce, after-sales and marketing.
forAgents.ctaTitle: Ready to be part of a fast-growing ecosystem?
forAgents.ctaBody: Connect with us to explore partnership opportunities and build sustainable success in Vietnam's pet care technology industry, together.

forSuppliers.title: Become a supplier for HELICORP
forSuppliers.intro: We're looking for reputable brands to build a sustainable future together, bringing new pet care technology to Vietnam. Over a decade of category leadership backs our commitment to long-term partnership.

sections.title: Optimizing Smart Supply Chains
sections.body: Distribution services built on a proven omnichannel system, with transport, storage and product insurance handled for you, adaptable to each brand's go-to-market strategy.

sections.title: Market Expansion & Superior Access
sections.body: Official exclusive distribution for PETKIT, NEAKASA, PETREE and Dr.VET, plus in-house brands HELIPET and Max Clean — the same playbook that took PETKIT to an 80% e-commerce share, now available to your brand across online, offline and B2B channels.

sections.title: Effective Business Framework
sections.body: Flexible commercial models tailored to your product portfolio and channel mix, built to maximize growth and efficiency.

sections.title: Collaborative Development & Quality Enhancement
sections.body: Shared knowledge and technology to help raise product and service quality, with regular training on production skills, quality management and technical standards.

sections.title: Strategic & Long-Term Partnership
sections.body: A professional, established partner in pet care technology, working toward sustainable success and shaping where the industry goes next.

logistics.title: Strategic Import & Export
logistics.body: Customs clearance, conformity, delivery and import licensing handled end to end.

logistics.title: Modern Warehouse Management
logistics.body: Safe, professional storage and inventory management.

logistics.title: Flexible & Efficient Delivery
logistics.body: Nationwide delivery coordinated with reputable domestic and international carriers.

logistics.title: Service & Support Network
logistics.body: Authorized warranty services — exchange, repair, on-site service, installation and maintenance.

forSuppliers.ctaTitle: Bring your product to Vietnam's pet care market
forSuppliers.ctaBody: Become part of a pioneering supplier network and put your products in front of Vietnamese pet owners, together with HELICORP.

contactSupplier.sideNoteBody: If you have a pet care product ready for the Vietnamese market — or an idea for one — we'd like to hear about it. Our team evaluates fit across distribution, logistics and brand strategy before we talk terms.
